subject: Delete old deprecated cli program redis-trib (#281)
reason: The change only deletes src/redis-trib.rb, a deprecated standalone Ruby stub script that merely printed a deprecation notice pointing to redis-cli --cluster and exited 1, plus a comment-only edit in a Tcl test helper. No server code, no shipped binary (valkey-server, valkey-cli, valkey-benchmark, valkey-check-rdb/aof) and no runtime or protocol behaviour changes, so there is nothing a fuzzer scenario could exercise.
